name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en or ru

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: any: when any subagent starts or a plan is reported; savvy: only for savvy-flow workers and plans

showCost.title: Show the cost estimate
showCost.description: Draw the approximate cost (the ≈$ figure) in the panel, the cards and the compact header; the cost is still tracked

sessionNeed.title: Session needs you
sessionNeed.description: Light Needs you when this session asks you a question?

stages.title: Stage words
stages.description: Agent label words that move the bar, as word=phase[+done][+finish]; phase is plan, design, delegate, review or close. Empty: labels move nothing

watch.title: Plan files
watch.description: Globs (*, **, ?) of files whose checkboxes become the flow when this session edits them; a relative glob is the session folder's. Empty: no file is watched

statusWords.title: Status words
statusWords.description: For a watched file without checkboxes: the words of its key: status lines, as word=done, word=skip or word=<phase>. Empty: such files are not read

stepBrief.title: Step brief
stepBrief.description: savvy: only savvy-* workers are asked to report steps. flow: also any agent whose description names a task of the unfinished flow; it reports only if its type can call the step tool. flow adds about 160 tokens per matched spawn
